thesis: Fast-lane flag is a CRISIL upgrade from B+ to BB, which is lagging and still sub-investment grade. Operating data are going the wrong way: Q1 FY27 revenue -21.5% YoY, loss before tax Rs5.95cr, finance cost Rs5.25cr, EBITDA near zero. Positives are deleveraging steps (MRA closure, Rs40cr promoter-group equity at Rs115.34, above the current price of Rs109.29). Dossier CFO/PAT 3.03 and its 'productive growth' class conflict with the loss and receivables growing 43% against revenue 8%. No demand/supply/pricing evidence. Reject for now; revisit only on revenue growth and positive EBITDA.
